title: NYPD Reviews Use of Flock Safety AI License Plate Readers

agency_candidates.display_name: New York City Department of Environmental Protection PD
University of New Haven CT PD

summary: The NYPD is reviewing hundreds of instances in which officers used Flock Safety's license plate reader database despite the department having no contract with Flock. Advocacy groups LatinoJustice and S.T.O.P. revealed at least 24 officers ran 1,710 Flock searches between March 2023 and December 2024, often without documented justification. The NYPD also enacted new June rules requiring supervisor approval for vendor engagements.

key_quotes.quote: The NYPD is reviewing hundreds of instances in which officers used Flock Safety, a controversial nationwide license plate reader network that uses artificial intelligence
NYPD officers used Flock 1,710 times between March 2023 and last December, noting that in 614 of the license plate searches, officers either did not say what the search was for
The NYPD in October told Flock it was not interested in entering into a contract, in part because the department already works with another firm, Vigilant Solutions
